text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"I thought I already knew from the start 
that I was taking on a difficult path, 
but..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Even so—I wish to offer you glory. That is 
why I have challenged this—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —Reality is never so kind, is it...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
In the world of competition, perhaps my 
feelings were nothing more than petals 
scattering in the wind.
choice_data_list: Do you... want to give up now?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
If I lack the heart and the skill... then 
I'll just make them bloom.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Even when exposed to the storm of 
adversity, it will never scatter— the 
flower of resolve within me.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Until the day you hold that golden 
bouquet, Trainer— so that I will never 
break.
choice_data_list:
Then let's make sure to build a solid 
foundation.

...All right. Let's be a bit strict about 
this.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes. In order to make beautiful flowers 
bloom... good soil is essential.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Let us review things from the ground up 
once more, and cultivate an unshakeable 
body and conviction."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
It's all right. Tending to flowers is―― 
something I'm actually quite good at.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Flowers exposed to harsh 
environments――adapt, and strive to grow 
stronger.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
This is a good opportunity to reaffirm 
your resolve once more.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Let us overcome this and bloom a flower 
that will never scatter—even in a 
tempestuous world.
